gloss: cold soba noodles served on a bamboo strainer

definitions.gloss: cold soba noodles served on a bamboo strainer
definitions.explanation: Chilled buckwheat noodles served on a bamboo draining basket (ざる), eaten by dipping in a cold soy-based sauce. A classic summer dish popular year-round.

examples.japanese: ざるそば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ざるそば⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べたく→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: On hot days, I crave cold soba noodles.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ざるそば⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手打|てう}ち→手打ち：13451_teuchi⟧で、のどごし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よくて→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This shop's cold soba is handmade, has a smooth texture, and is popular.

notes:
Named after the ⟦ざる→ざる：04470_zaru⟧ (bamboo strainer basket) on which the noodles are served. The noodles are boiled, rinsed in cold water, and placed on the basket. Eaten by dipping into つゆ (dipping sauce) with condiments like {刻|きざ}みねぎ (chopped green onion) and わさび.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ざるそば⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧: one serving of cold soba (counted with ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧)
- ⟦{大盛|おおも}り→大盛り：08162_oomori⟧ざるそば: large serving of cold soba
- ⟦{手打|てう}ち→手打ち：13451_teuchi⟧ざるそば: handmade cold soba

SIMILAR WORDS:
- もりそば: plain cold soba — very similar, but traditionally served without nori seaweed topping; the distinction has blurred in modern usage
- かけそば: hot soba in broth — soba served in hot soup, the warm counterpart to ざるそば
- つけめん: dipping noodles — a ramen variant with the same dipping style but using wheat noodles and richer broth
